name: Lego Ninja Game 2
author: TimDaTurdle
description: This game is my second installment in this series. I made this using a few prefabs. This game broke during the finishing steps, right before I could add a win brick. So, as a replacement, I will give you a quest.                                               Cross the parkour challenge using Master Wu and get to the skull island at the end. And, as an added challenge, find the Destiny's Bounty airship as a collectible. Have fun!                                                                                                         Controls: Space: Jump        Space midair: Air jump up to 2 times.                                WASD: Move         TAB: Pause/options             Consider commenting future ideas!                                                                                                                                      Thank you,                                                                                                                      TimDaTurdleGames
